purpose: Teach: 見捨て/テック/送り出し/王家/シリアル/樽/鍛える/野心

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お友達を、絶対、見捨てないからね、約束、本当に、ね、ママに、伝えておきたいんだ、本気で。
lines.en: Mom, I want you to know — I'll never abandon my friends. I'm really serious about this. I need you to hear it.
lines.style: Urgent, eyes bright with conviction. Speaks with careful deliberation, each phrase a small promise. Sits up straighter. No rushing, but no hesitation either.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。お父さんの会社、テック関係の、新事業、始めたって、聞いたわよ、翔くん、楽しみね、本当に、家族で、応援しようね。
lines.en: Mmm. I heard your dad started a new tech venture at his company. That's exciting, isn't it, Sho? We should all support him as a family.
lines.style: Gentle, warm recognition. Soft nod. Gaze is present but reflective, like she's thinking aloud rather than lecturing. Unhurried cadence.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 今朝、玄関で、ぼく、ママの、送り出し、ちゃんと、できたよね、お母さん、覚えてる?ぼく、頑張ったの、本当に。
lines.en: This morning at the door — I said goodbye to you properly, remember? I really tried hard, Mom.
lines.style: Quiet pride in the small thing. Voice lifts slightly on 'remember' — seeking confirmation, not bragging. Straightforward and plain, like he's handing her evidence of his care.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 絵本、王家のお話、翔くん、好きだよね、お母さん、もう一冊、買ってあげるね、約束、ね、楽しみにしててね、絶対。
lines.en: You love those storybooks about royal families, don't you? I've already bought you another one. It's a promise, so you'd better look forward to it.
lines.style: Warm and playful certainty. Gentle tease in the voice — the kind that says 'I know you well.' Slower pace on the promise. A smile underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 今朝、シリアル、ぼく、自分で、用意したよ、ママ、お母さん、忙しそうだったから、お手伝いしたんだ、本当に、嬉しい。
lines.en: This morning I got my own cereal ready. You looked busy, so I helped out. I was really happy doing that.
lines.style: Bright and matter-of-fact pride. Quick, eager delivery. Slight lift at the end — not fishing for praise but genuinely pleased with himself. Young voice, uncomplicated joy.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さん、ワイン樽の、コルク、集めてるって、知ってた?翔くん、お父さん、本当に、面白い趣味、持ってるわよね。
lines.en: Did you know your dad collects wine bottle corks? He's got quite the hobby going. Your father's got some pretty interesting interests, doesn't he?
lines.style: Conversational, slightly amused observation. Warm tone, like she's sharing something fond about him with Sho. Reflective but not distant. A small smile lives in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お父さん、ジムで、体を、鍛えるのに、最近、はまってるんだよね、ママ、ぼくも、お父さんみたいに、なりたいよ、絶対。
lines.en: Your dad's been really into training at the gym lately, hasn't he? I want to be like Dad when I grow up, Mom. I really do.
lines.style: Earnest admiration, straightforward and unguarded. Voice steady on the declaration. No apology, no hedge. Simple conviction from a child who means what he says.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くんの、野心、ぼく、大きく、なって、何になりたい?お母さん、聞いてみたいよ、本気で、楽しみよ、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: With all that ambition in you — as you grow up, what do you want to become? I'd really like to hear it. I'm looking forward to knowing.
lines.style: Genuine curiosity, no rush. Lean-in quality to the listening. Warm close, almost intimate. Inviting him to share something real. Patient hold at the end.
